input.quote: 14.2 Upon creation and subject to payment of the applicable Fees, Customer owns each Deliverable created specifically for Customer. Vendor hereby assigns to Customer all worldwide right, title, and interest in those Deliverables and shall obtain equivalent assignments from its personnel.
input.rationale: The IP package matches our preferred position. Section 14.1 confirms Customer owns Customer Data, Customer Confidential Information and independently developed IP, with only a limited processing right to Vendor to provide the Services for Customer. Section 14.2 vests Deliverables in Customer with an express Vendor assignment and personnel assignments plus further-assurance. Section 14.3 lets Vendor keep only Vendor Technology (defined at 1.9 as pre-existing material excluding Customer Data and Customer-owned IP) and routes embedded Vendor Technology to the Section 13.2 perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, modify, create derivative works and permit contractors to support the material. Section 14.4 bars joint ownership absent a signed instrument setting out exploitation rights and keeps feedback voluntary with Customer retaining unrestricted use. No provision assigns Customer IP or Customer Data to Vendor, and no aggregated/de-identified data carve-out exists. No redline required.
